2 حشّى , (TA,) inf. n. تَحْشِيَةٌ, (KL, TA,) He made a حَاشِيَة to a garment, or piece of cloth. (KL.) ―
-b2- And [hence,] (assumed tropical:) He wrote a note or comment, or notes or comments, upon the margin, or margins, of a book: (KL, TA:) in this sense it is vulgar [or post-classical]. (TA.) ＝
-A2- [Also, app., He, or it, caused one to breathe short or unintermittedly, to pant for breath, or to be out of breath: see مُحَشِّيَةُ الكِلَابِ, below.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
